bio.text: According to a July 2025 campaign press release, Floyd Taylor of Hardinsburg, Indiana, filed to run as an independent for Indiana's 9th Congressional District, unaffiliated with any political party or PAC.
The release describes him as a technologist whose background includes launching Jeffnet, an early non-commercial internet provider in Oregon, and decades of work in IT infrastructure.

sources.title: Floyd Taylor Files for Congress in Indiana's 9th District as Independent Candidate
